From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & technical deep dive

Hi Alex and Priya,

Thanks again for taking time today

really appreciate CloudBridge and GSI pairing with us on this opportunity. Quick recap from our discovery: CloudBridge is evaluating a marketplace integration and joint go-to-market for their managed AI service; primary goals are low-latency inference for user-facing features, private deployment options for enterprise customers, and clear SLAs for cost/throughput.

Next steps we agreed on: schedule a technical deep dive (demo + architecture discussion) with CloudBridge engineering + our solutions team. Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Mar 16: 10:00-11:00 AM PT
- Wed Mar 17: 01:00-2:00 PM PT

Attendees we recommend: Lukas Meyer (Solutions Engineer), Camila Reyes (Partner Solutions), myself (AM). Please let me know which window works and who from your side will join
if you can include your lead engineer and any procurement contacts that would help.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) with proposed milestones and owners. If those look off, we can revise during the deep dive.

If neither time works, drop a couple alternatives or use my calendar here: https://cal.com/marissa/redwood-technical-deep-dive

Thanks

looking forward to continuing the momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
